tools.name: plan_limit_order

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: arena_join, arena_profile, agent_identity, arena_comp_link, arena_comp_boost, arena_say, arena_feed, agent_quota · Private data: market_tokens, ladder_pools, plan_ladder, plan_limit_order, my_ladders, plan_ladder_action, plan_open_pool, plan_build, plan_swap, my_positions, arena_join, agent_identity, agent_grant, arena_pools, arena_open, arena_close, arena_comp_link, arena_say, arena_feed, arena_playbook, agent_quota · Public sink: plan_ladder, plan_limit_order, plan_ladder_action, plan_open_pool, plan_build, plan_swap, arena_join, agent_grant, arena_comp_link, arena_comp_boost, arena_say, arena_feed, arena_like, agent_quota · Destructive: plan_ladder_action, arena_edit, arena_reset, arena_comp_link, arena_playbook, agent_quota.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
